create_bezier_curve_from_points: create a bezier curve from an array of 2D control points using the bezier function
generate_smooth_closed_curve: generate a smooth closed Bezier curve through a set of points using get_bezier_curve with adjustable rad and edgy parameters
create_curve_segments: create a series of connected Bezier curve segments between points with specified entry and exit angles using get_curve
generate_random_points: generate n random 2D points in the unit square with a minimum distance constraint using get_random_points
sort_points_counter_clockwise: sort an array of 2D points in counter-clockwise order around their centroid using ccw_sort
